questions.question: When was the first meeting of the Constituent Assembly of India held?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The first sitting of the Constituent Assembly took place on December 9, 1946. Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was elected as the temporary President for this session.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान सभा की पहली बैठक 9 दिसंबर, 1946 को हुई थी। डॉ. सच्चिदानंद सिन्हा को इस सत्र के लिए अस्थायी अध्यक्ष चुना गया था।

questions.question: Who was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946, two days after its first meeting.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद को 9 दिसंबर 1946 को पहली बैठक के दो दिन बाद 11 दिसंबर 1946 को संविधान सभा का स्थायी अध्यक्ष चुना गया था।

questions.question: According to whose plan was the Constituent Assembly of India formed?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Constituent Assembly was formed in 1946 according to the provisions of the Cabinet Mission Plan, which was accepted by both the Congress and the Muslim League.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान सभा का गठन 1946 में कैबिनेट मिशन योजना के प्रावधानों के अनुसार किया गया था, जिसे कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग दोनों ने स्वीकार कर लिया था।

questions.question: The Objectives Resolution, which later became the Preamble of the Constitution, was presented by:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Jawaharlal Nehru presented the Objective Resolution in the Constituent Assembly on December 13, 1946. It was unanimously adopted by the Assembly on January 22, 1947.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने 13 दिसंबर 1946 को संविधान सभा में उद्देश्य संकल्प/प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत किया था। इसे 22 जनवरी 1947 को सभा द्वारा सर्वसम्मति से अपनाया गया था।

questions.question: When was the Constitution of India adopted by the Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Constitution was adopted and enacted by the people of India on November 26, 1949, which is also celebrated as 'Constitution Day' or 'Samvidhan Diwas'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान को 26 नवंबर, 1949 को भारत के लोगों द्वारा अपनाया और अधिनियमित किया गया था, जिसे 'संविधान दिवस' के रूप में भी मनाया जाता है।

questions.question: Who was the first person to demand a Constituent Assembly for India in 1934?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
M. N. Roy, a pioneer of the Communist movement in India, first put forward the idea of a Constituent Assembly for India in 1934.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारत में कम्युनिस्ट आंदोलन के प्रणेता एम. एन. रॉय ने 1934 में भारत के लिए संविधान सभा का विचार सबसे पहले सामने रखा था।

questions.question: Who was the Constitutional Advisor to the Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sir B. N. Rao was appointed as the Legal/Constitutional Advisor to the Constituent Assembly to provide expert legal assistance and advice.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सर बी. एन. राव को विशेषज्ञ कानूनी सहायता और सलाह प्रदान करने के लिए संविधान सभा के कानूनी/संवैधानिक सलाहकार के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया था।

questions.question: The total time taken to frame the Indian Constitution was:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Constituent Assembly held 11 sessions over a period of 2 years, 11 months, and 17/18 days to finalize the Constitution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान को अंतिम रूप देने के लिए संविधान सभा ने 2 साल, 11 महीने और 17/18 दिनों की अवधि में 11 सत्र आयोजित किए थे।

questions.question: Who was the Chief Draftsman of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The chief drafter of the Constitution of India was S. N. Mukherjee. He worked to accurately translate the discussions and proposals of the Constituent Assembly into legal language.
5. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar led the drafting of the Constitution as Chairman, but S. N. Mukherjee played a key role in finalizing it.
6. B. N. Rao – Constitutional Advisor, who prepared the initial draft.
7. Prem Bihari Narayan Raizada – who wrote the Constitution in beautiful handwriting.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारत के संविधान के मुख्य प्रारूपकार एस. एन. मुखर्जी थे। उन्होंने संविधान सभा की चर्चाओं और प्रस्तावों को कानूनी भाषा में सटीक रूप से रूपांतरित करने का कार्य किया।
8. संविधान के प्रारूप को तैयार करने में डॉ. बी. आर. अंबेडकर ने अध्यक्ष के रूप में नेतृत्व किया, लेकिन एस. एन. मुखर्जी ने उसे अंतिम रूप देने में अहम भूमिका निभाई।
9. बी. एन. राव – संवैधानिक सलाहकार, जिन्होंने प्रारंभिक मसौदा तैयार किया।
10. प्रेम बिहारी नारायण रायज़ादा – जिन्होंने संविधान को सुंदर हस्तलिपि में लिखा।

questions.question: Who among the following was NOT a member of the Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mahatma Gandhi – was not a member of the Constituent Assembly because by that time he had withdrawn from active politics and was focused on social and moral reconstruction after independence. He was the spiritual leader of the independence movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
महात्मा गांधी – संविधान सभा के सदस्य नहीं थे, क्योंकि उस समय तक वे सक्रिय राजनीति से अलग हो चुके थे और स्वतंत्रता के बाद उनके ध्यान का केंद्र सामाजिक व नैतिक पुनर्निर्माण था। वे स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के आध्यात्मिक नेता थे

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the composition of the Constituent Assembly is/are correct?
1. The total strength of the Assembly was 389.
2. 296 seats were allotted to British India and 93 seats to the Princely States.
3. The seats allotted to British India were to be divided among Muslim, Sikh, and General communities.
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All three statements are correct regarding the provisions of the Cabinet Mission Plan. The total seats were 389, divided into 296 (British India) and 93 (Princely States). Seats in British provinces were divided among Muslim, Sikh, and General communities.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कैबिनेट मिशन योजना के प्रावधानों के संबंध में तीनों कथन सही हैं। कुल सीटें 389 थीं, जिन्हें 296 (ब्रिटिश भारत) और 93 (रियासतें) में विभाजित किया गया था। ब्रिटिश प्रांतों में सीटें मुस्लिम, सिख और सामान्य समुदायों के बीच विभाजित थीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of committees and their chairmen in the Constituent Assembly:
1. Union Powers Committee: Jawaharlal Nehru
2. Provincial Constitution Committee: Sardar Patel
3. Rules of Procedure Committee: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
 Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Rules of Procedure Committee was chaired by Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee. Hence, only 1 and 2 are correctly matched.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रक्रिया नियम समिति की अध्यक्षता डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद ने की थी। डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर प्रारूप समिति के अध्यक्ष थे। इसलिए, केवल 1 और 2 सही ढंग से मेल खाते हैं।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): Mahatma Gandhi was not a member of the Constituent Assembly of India.
 Reason (R): The Constituent Assembly comprised only elected and nominated members from British India and Princely States.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
5. Assertion (A) is correct—Mahatma Gandhi was not actually a member of the Constituent Assembly.
6. Reason (R) is also correct—The Constituent Assembly consisted only of elected and nominated members from British India and the princely states.
But Gandhiji was not a member of the Constituent Assembly not because the Assembly consisted only of elected and nominated members, but because he himself did not participate in the elections and did not express his desire to become a member.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
7. अभिकथन (A) सही है — महात्मा गांधी वास्तव में संविधान सभा के सदस्य नहीं थे।
8. कारण (R) भी सही है — संविधान सभा में केवल ब्रिटिश भारत और रियासतों से निर्वाचित तथा मनोनीत सदस्य शामिल थे।
लेकिन गांधीजी का संविधान सभा का सदस्य न होना इस कारण नहीं था कि सभा में केवल निर्वाचित और मनोनीत सदस्य थे, बल्कि इसलिए था क्योंकि उन्होंने स्वयं चुनाव में भाग नहीं लिया और सदस्य बनने की इच्छा नहीं जताई।

questions.question:
Which of the following pairs of Constituent Assembly committees and their chairmen is correctly matched?
 1. Union Constitution Committee — Dr. Rajendra Prasad
 2. Drafting Committee — Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
 3. Provincial Constitution Committee — Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
 4. States Committee (Committee for Negotiating with the States) — Jawaharlal Nehru
 Options:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Pair 1 is incorrect because the Union Constitution Committee was chaired by Jawaharlal Nehru, not Dr. Rajendra Prasad.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
युग्म 1 गलत है, क्योंकि संघ संविधान समिति के अध्यक्ष जवाहरलाल नेहरू थे, न कि डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद।

questions.question:
The Interim Government was formed in 1946. Which of the following leaders of the Muslim League (ML) were part of this government?
1. Liaquat Ali Khan
2. Ibrahim Ismail Chundrigar
3. Jogendra Nath Mandal
4. C. Rajagopalachari
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Liaquat Ali Khan (Finance), Ibrahim Ismail Chundrigar (Commerce), Jogendra Nath Mandal (Law), Ghazanfar Ali Khan (Health), and Abdur Rab Nishtar (Railways) were the Muslim League members in the Interim Government.
9. C. Rajagopalachari (Education and Arts) was from the INC.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
10. लियाकत अली खान (वित्त), इब्राहिम इस्माइल चुंदरीगर (वाणिज्य), जोगेंद्र नाथ मंडल (कानून), ग़ज़नफ़र अली खान (स्वास्थ्य), और अब्दुर रब निश्तार (रेलवे) अंतरिम सरकार में मुस्लिम लीग के सदस्य थे।
11. सी. राजगोपालाचारी (शिक्षा और कला) कांग्रेस से थे।

questions.question:
Which of the following provisions of the Constitution came into effect on November 26, 1949, upon its adoption?
1. Citizenship
2. Elections
3. Provisional Parliament
4. Fundamental Rights
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Only some provisions related to Citizenship (Art 5, 6, 7, 8, 9), Elections, and Provisional Parliament were enforced immediately on November 26, 1949. The rest of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights, came into force on January 26, 1950.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नागरिकता (अनुच्छेद 5, 6, 7, 8, 9), चुनाव और अंतरिम संसद से संबंधित केवल कुछ प्रावधान 26 नवंबर, 1949 को तुरंत लागू किए गए थे। मौलिक अधिकारों सहित शेष संविधान 26 जनवरी, 1950 को लागू हुआ।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The Congress rejected the August Offer of 1940 and the Cripps Proposal of 1942.
 Reason (R): Both the proposals offered the 'Dominion Status' which was less than the 'Purna Swaraj' demanded by the Congress.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Congress had demanded 'Purna Swaraj' (complete independence) in 1929. Since the August Offer and Cripps Proposal offered only 'Dominion Status' (self-governing within the British Empire), the Congress rejected them as insufficient.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कांग्रेस ने 1929 में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' (पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता) की मांग की थी। चूंकि अगस्त प्रस्ताव और क्रिप्स प्रस्ताव ने केवल 'डोमिनियन स्टेटस' (ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य के भीतर स्व-शासन) की पेशकश की, कांग्रेस ने उन्हें अपर्याप्त मानते हुए अस्वीकार कर दिया।

questions.question:
Consider the following regarding the Drafting Committee:
1. It was set up on August 29, 1947.
2. It had a total of 7 members, including the Chairman.
3. The committee took 141 days to prepare its draft.
 How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Drafting Committee was formed on August 29, 1947, with Dr. B. R. Ambedkar as Chairman and six other members, totaling seven.
8. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (Chairman)
9. N. Gopalaswami Iyengar
10. Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer
11. K. M. Munshi
12. Syed Mohammad Saadulla
13. B. L. Mitter (resigned → replaced by N. Madhava Rau)
14. D. P. Khaitan (died → replaced by T. T. Krishnamachari)
The committee worked on its draft for 141 days.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रारूप समिति का गठन 29 अगस्त, 1947 को किया गया था, जिसमें डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर अध्यक्ष और 6 अन्य सदस्य थे, जिनकी कुल संख्या 7 थी।
15. डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर (अध्यक्ष)
16. एन. गोपालस्वामी आयंगर
17. अल्लादी कृष्णस्वामी अय्यर
18. के. एम. मुंशी
19. सैयद मोहम्मद सादुल्ला
20. बी. एल. मित्तर (बाद में फिर एन. माधव राव)
21. डी. पी. खैतान (टी. टी. कृष्णमाचारी बाद में शामिल)
समिति ने अपने मसौदे पर 141 दिनों तक काम किया था।

questions.question: Which of the following sub-committees was NOT headed by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel?

options.b: Advisory Committee on Minority, Tribal and Excluded Areas

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sardar Patel chaired the Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities and Tribal and Excluded Areas, and the Provincial Constitution Committee, but he was not the Chairman of the State Committee. The State Committee was chaired by Jawaharlal Nehru.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरदार पटेल ने मौलिक अधिकारों, अल्पसंख्यकों और आदिवासी तथा बहिष्कृत क्षेत्रों पर सलाहकार समिति, प्रांतीय संविधान समिति की अध्यक्षता की, लेकिन वह राज्य समिति के अध्यक्ष नहीं थे। राज्य समिति के अध्यक्ष जवाहर लाल नेहरू थे।

questions.question:
Assertion (A): The Constituent Assembly served as the first Parliament of independent India after the Constitution was enforced.
 Reason (R): The Constituent Assembly had two major functions: Constitution making and functioning as a law-making body.

options.a: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.b: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.c: A is true but R is false.
options.d: A is false but R is true.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Constituent Assembly was granted the dual role of Constitution maker (chaired by Dr. Rajendra Prasad) and a law-making body (chaired by G. V. Mavalankar) on different days. Once the Constitution was enforced, it functioned as the Provisional Parliament of India till the first general elections of 1951-52.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान सभा को अलग-अलग दिनों में संविधान निर्माता (डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद की अध्यक्षता में) और कानून बनाने वाली संस्था (जी. वी. मावलंकर की अध्यक्षता में) की दोहरी भूमिका दी गई थी। एक बार संविधान लागू होने के बाद, इसने 1951-52 के पहले आम चुनावों तक भारत की अंतरिम संसद के रूप में कार्य किया।

questions.question: With regard to the Constitution, which of the following options is incorrect?

options.a: The last sitting of the Constituent Assembly was held on November 26, 1949.
options.b: 284 members of the Constituent Assembly signed the handwritten Constitution on January 24, 1950.
options.c: The President of the Constituent Assembly, Dr. Rajendra Prasad, was elected as the first President of India on January 26, 1950.
options.d: The Constitution enforced on January 26, 1950, originally contained 22 Parts and 8 Schedules.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The final meeting was held on January 24, 1950, where 284 members signed the Constitution. Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected President and assumed office on January 26, 1950. The original Constitution consisted of 22 parts and eight schedules.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंतिम बैठक 24 जनवरी, 1950 को हुई थी, जहाँ 284 सदस्यों ने संविधान पर हस्ताक्षर किए थे। डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद को 26 जनवरी, 1950 को राष्ट्रपति चुना गया था और उन्होंने पदभार संभाला। मूल संविधान में 22 भाग और 8 अनुसूचियाँ थीं।

questions.question:
Which among the following were adopted by the Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950?
1. National Anthem
2. National Song
3. Election of the first Vice President of India
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
1&2 events took place on January 24, 1950. This date marks the last sitting of the Constituent Assembly, during which the National Anthem (Jana Gana Mana) and National Song (Vande Mataram) were adopted.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1&2 घटनाएँ 24 जनवरी, 1950 को हुई थीं। यह तिथि संविधान सभा की अंतिम बैठक को चिह्नित करती है, जिसके दौरान राष्ट्रीय गान (जन गण मन) और राष्ट्रीय गीत (वंदे मातरम) को अपनाया गया था|

questions.question: Identify the female member of the Constituent Assembly who became the first female Chief Minister of an Indian state (Uttar Pradesh):
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sucheta Kriplani was an important female member of the Constituent Assembly. She later became the first female Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. Raj Kumari Amritkaur was the first health minister, and Sarojini Naidu was the first Governor of Uttar Pradesh.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सुचेता कृपलानी संविधान सभा की एक महत्वपूर्ण महिला सदस्य थीं। बाद में वह उत्तर प्रदेश की पहली महिला मुख्यमंत्री बनीं। राजकुमारी अमृतकौर पहली स्वास्थ्य मंत्री थीं, और सरोजिनी नायडू उत्तर प्रदेश की पहली राज्यपाल थीं।

questions.question: Who was the calligrapher who penned the handwritten English version of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Prem Bihari Narayan Raizada was the calligrapher who handwrote the original English version of the Constitution. The Hindi version was handwritten by Vasant Krishna Vaidya. The original Constitution was decorated by Nandalal Bose and Byohar Rammanohar Sinha.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रेम बिहारी नारायण रायज़ादा वह सुलेखाकार थे जिन्होंने संविधान का मूल अंग्रेजी संस्करण हस्तलिखित किया था। हिंदी संस्करण का सुलेख वसंत कृष्ण वैद्य द्वारा किया गया था। मूल संविधान को नंदलाल बोस और ब्योहार राममनोहर सिन्हा द्वारा सजाया गया था।

questions.question: The provisions for the division of seats (296 for British India) in the Constituent Assembly included the allocation of one seat for approximately how much population?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
One seat was to be allotted for every one million (10 lakh) of the population in the provinces under British rule. This was the basis for the indirect election of 296 members from British India.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ब्रिटिश शासन के अधीन प्रांतों में प्रत्येक दस लाख (1 मिलियन) जनसंख्या पर एक सीट आवंटित की जानी थी। यह ब्रिटिश भारत से 296 सदस्यों के अप्रत्यक्ष चुनाव का आधार था।
